title: Public MQTT Broker (broker.emqx.io) Without TLS or Authentication
description: The background monitoring service connects to a public multi-tenant MQTT broker (`broker.emqx.io`) on cleartext port 1883 without TLS or client authentication to exchange device control commands.
attack_vector: Any external actor can subscribe to wildcard topics on `broker.emqx.io` to eavesdrop on telemetry or publish forged commands that remotely disable child monitoring protections.
fix_rationale: Deploy a dedicated private MQTT broker enforcing TLS on port 8883 (`..secure = true`) with per-device client certificate or username/token ACL authentication.
